text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 3: An XGBoost model given ICON-D2 follows measured power at every generator, across a windy, a variable, and a calm week'
text.tspan: Figure 3: An XGBoost model given ICON-D2 follows measured power at every
generator, across a windy, a variable, and a calm week

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Out-of-fold power as a percentage of the generator's own capacity. Weeks are picked from measured power alone, pooled over the three generators: the windiest has the highest mean output, the calmest the lowest, and the most variable the largest swing in daily mean output. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, August 2024 to September 2026.'
text.tspan: Out-of-fold power as a percentage of the generator's own capacity.
Weeks are picked from measured power alone, pooled over the three generators: the windiest has the highest mean
output, the calmest the lowest, and the most variable the largest swing in daily mean output.
Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, August 2024 to September 2026.
